'''Ras Laffan C power plant''' (محطة رأس لفان "س" لتوليد الطاقة وتحلية المياه) is an operating power station of at least 2732-megawatts (MW) in Ras Laffan Industrial City, Zone 75, Al Khor, Qatar.
It is also known as Ras Laffan C power and desalination plant, Ras Qartas Energy Plant.
